fn-unseen-03.front: How many cone types do deer have?
fn-unseen-03.back: Two. They lack the long wavelength red cone.

fn-unseen-04.front: Which clothing colour is worst for deer?
fn-unseen-04.back: Blue. They likely see it well.

fn-unseen-05.front: How does blaze orange look to a deer?
fn-unseen-05.back: Dull, close to brown or grey (75%).

fn-unseen-06.back: No rule found in the Hunt Mentor Rule Book (85%, my reading). VERIFY in the synopsis.

fn-unseen-07.back: Pattern. The fabric colour matters little if the pattern blends.

fn-unseen-13.front: How to check clothes for UV brighteners?
fn-unseen-13.back: UV flashlight in a dark room: a blue white glow means brighteners.
fn-unseen-13.diagram:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 300" role="img" aria-label="Clothes that glow bright blue white under UV hold optical brighteners.">
